what_it_does: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique where an AI model looks up relevant documents before answering—like a student checking a textbook before writing an essay. The problem is that different RAG variants have wildly different workloads: some spend time searching for documents, others rerank results, others generate long answers. RAGO provides a systematic way to characterize any RAG pipeline and apply targeted optimizations—smart scheduling, resource partitioning, and batching—tuned to each variant's specific bottleneck, rather than treating all RAG as standard model inference.
